title: Edge-Boundary-Texture Loss: A Tri-Class Generalization of Weighted Binary Cross-Entropy for Enhanced Edge Detection
mechanism: Split pixels into edge, boundary (near-edge) and texture classes, each with its own supervisory weight, generalising weighted BCE.
adaptation: Crack / 1-2 px ring around the label skeleton / rest; low weight (0.2) on the ring so firing on the ridge 1 px off the drawn line is barely punished; applied to the crack channel of the 24-class CE.
min_experiment: Arm PF with EBT ring weights vs PF; metric relF1@2 and width ratio; kill if relF1@2 +<0.01 or width ratio >1.2.
evidence: Beats WBCE across several edge benchmarks with one fixed hyperparameter set; numbers not read.
prior_overlap: partial: BRIEF 5 offset-tolerant CE (n.d.) used tolerance, not near-crack down-weighting; open
